hp_faq_q1: How do I create a new trip?
hp_faq_a1: To create a new trip, click on 'My Trips' in the navigation bar, then click the 'Create New Trip' button. Enter your trip details, add a cover photo, and start adding activities!
hp_faq_q2: Can I share my itinerary with friends?
hp_faq_a2: Yes! When creating or editing a trip, you can add collaborators by entering their email addresses. They'll receive an invitation to join your trip.
hp_faq_q3: How do I add activities to my itinerary?
hp_faq_a3: Open your trip, go to the Itinerary tab, and click 'Add Activity'. Fill in the activity details like name, location, address, and date. You can also upload photos!
hp_faq_q4: How can I bookmark other people's itineraries?
hp_faq_a4: Visit the Feed page, browse itineraries shared by other users, and click the bookmark icon on any post to save it to your profile.
hp_faq_q5: Can I edit or delete my activities?
hp_faq_a5: Yes! Open your trip, click on the activity you want to modify, and use the Edit or Delete buttons. Changes are saved instantly.
